environment:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art environment sprite atlas for Arcana, an original bright lived-in magical city.
Create ONE transparent 1536 x 1024 PNG sprite sheet. EXACT regular 3 columns x 2 rows of 512 x 512 cells. NO labels, text, grid lines or surrounding scene. Every object isolated with transparent padding, strictly within its own cell. All objects orthographic top-down 3/4 RPG view: visible front facade and roof, horizontal front edges, NOT isometric diamonds. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters at a logical 128 x 128 per cell, displayed 4x nearest-neighbor. No gradients, blur or painterly noise. Flat material ramps of 3-5 tones, warm sandstone ivory, honey oak, deep teal and blue roof, sage leaves; sunlight from upper left, shadow lower right. Sophisticated cozy handcrafted architecture, grounded realistic proportions.
Cell order left-to-right:
Top row: (1) apothecary/general shop, compact two-storey warm plaster and sandstone facade, a broad dark teal tiled hipped roof, wooden beams, left window with bottles and striped cream/teal awning, right wooden arched entrance at lower center, hanging small brass flask sign, potted plants; (2) matching inn, taller slate blue roof with dormer, ivy along left wall, oak arched entrance lower center, small hanging moon sign; (3) matching restaurant, turquoise roof, cream/terracotta fabric awning on left, bread display, door lower center. Each building fills 440px wide and 460px tall at most, same consistent doors and adult character scale.
Bottom row: (4) ornate round sandstone fountain with a shallow elliptical turquoise water basin, carved rim, single central slender stone column with small luminous aqua crystal above, restrained flowing water, fills about 400 x 400 pixels; (5) broad rounded deciduous tree, asymmetrical layered olive/sage crown, visible gnarled oak trunk and roots, fills 410 x 460 pixels; (6) slender silver birch with graceful irregular mint foliage and white trunk, fills 360 x 460 pixels.
Only these six separate objects. Each rooted at exact center x of cell and base y=480 local cell pixels. Do not crop any roof, roots, shadows or foliage. No humans. No game UI. No premade game assets or copied designs. NO ground rectangles underneath sprites. Actual transparent alpha background.
characters:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original production RPG character direction sheet with actual transparent background, for Arcana.
Create a 1024 x 768 transparent PNG with EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows of 256 x 384 cells. Each cell depicts one whole adult RPG character viewed from top-down 3/4 (front wall/roof type game perspective, not isometric). Crisp deliberate pixel art: logical 32 x 48 pixels per cell magnified 8x with nearest-neighbor hard edges, no smooth painting, no gradients, no ground, no glow or shadows, no text or cell lines. Character feet consistently local y=360, centered x=128. Head roughly 1/6 of full body; NOT chibi.
Upper row SAME young adult adventurer, short chestnut hair, cream shirt, teal-blue mid-thigh fitted travel coat with ochre trim, dark brown belt and crossbody satchel, dark slim trousers, brown boots; views left-to-right FRONT (south), BACK (north), LEFT PROFILE (west), RIGHT PROFILE (east). All four share identical proportions, face, outfit, height. Arms relaxed, feet together grounded neutral stance.
Lower row SAME adult traveler, pale sandy short hair, muted sage-green cape over warm brown travel tunic, small backpack, dark trousers and leather boots; same four directions front, back, left, right.
Use expressive simple dark outlines, graphic hair shapes and 3-tone flat cel shading. Light upper left, warm skin, understated readable faces. Character illustration reference is STYLE ONLY for dark anime outline and cel shading: do not copy the elderly woman's identity, age, hairstyle, or clothing; the explicit Arcana pixel sprite requirement takes precedence over portrait rendering.
Each character entire silhouette within own cell with substantial transparent margins. Keep all eight exactly same scale and foot baseline, no posed action, no independent redesign between views. No staff, sword, hat, text, background scene or UI.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single production environment prop atlas for Arcana pixel RPG, original designs.
Create a 1024 x 1280 PNG with actual transparent background. STRICT 4 columns x 4 rows of 256 x 320 cells. Exactly sixteen ISOLATED objects, one per cell, no overlapping. Crisp native pixel art (64 x 80 logical cell magnified 4x nearest neighbor), large clean clusters, no gradients, no noisy micro-texture. Shared top-down 3/4 camera showing horizontal front faces and tops, NOT isometric diamond view. Warm sandstone, honey oak, dark teal metal, sage/olive foliage, cream linen, small amber glass. Upper-left daylight with restrained lower-right contact shadow. Consistent adult scale, no figures. Every object's bottom centered at local (128,300) with transparent padding. Assets fill appropriately, do not draw pedestal or floor rectangles.
